'''Sigea Broos''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was part of the Imperial strike team during the events of the [[Conquest of Makeb]] acting as a supply officer specializing in secondary gear.
